name: York Haven Fabricators
old_description: York Haven Fabricators (YHFAB) delivers custom fabrication services with precision results. Leveraging decades of manufacturing experience, state-of-the-art manufacturing technologies and expert automation, we combine sheet metal fabrication, heavy gauge forming, and welding processes with CNC machining and finishing operations in a single, highly integrated facility.
about:
York Haven Fabricators (YHFAB) operates from York Haven, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1998 by Henry Shefet as a division of Daisy Data (established 1982), it became independent in 2000 and added 40,000 square feet in 2001. In 2025, S&W Metal Products—a Pennsylvania fabricator since 1946—acquired the company, merging over 100 years of manufacturing experience.

YHFAB delivers custom metal fabrication and CNC machining from a 160,000-square-foot facility with 109+ employees and 160+ machines. Integrated services include fiber laser cutting, CNC press brake forming, robotic bending, turret punching, MIG/TIG/spot and robotic welding, plate rolling, finishing, and 5-axis milling and live-tooling turning. The shop runs prototype to high-volume production, shipping 16,000+ line items annually, with in-house engineering, CAD/CAM programming, and design-for-manufacture support.

Customers span commercial, service, automotive, lighting, energy, material handling, factory automation, electronics enclosures, military, medical, packaging, and transportation markets. Examples include parts for material handling and automation systems, automotive Tier 1/2 components, commercial lighting fixtures, electronic enclosures for industrial and utility use, and critical oil, gas, and renewable energy parts.

The company cites its single-facility integration of fabrication, machining, welding, and finishing, an ISO 9001:2015 system (certified since 2012), advanced automation (robotic welding, high-throughput laser loading), real-time MRP tracking, and inspection via Virtek LaserQC (±0.002 in) and FARO Edge CMM (±0.0014 in) as key differentiators.
